environment.description: Application deployed behind AWS ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action (priority 1), and (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' (priority 2) containing a single rule that inspects the QueryString component using a RegexPatternSet matching the pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d|--\s*$|/\*.*\*/|(?:benchmark|sleep|waitfor)\s*\()` with action BLOCK. Additionally, the ALB target group has a Lambda@Edge function (associated via CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB) that URL-decodes all query parameters twice before forwarding, preventing double-encoding bypass. The WAFv2 text transformation chain on the QueryString field applies URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE before regex evaluation.

config.waf: AWS WAFv2 WebACL with AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet + custom RegexPatternSet rule on QueryString
config.double_decode_protection: Lambda@Edge performs pre-normalization of query strings
